answer: Reputation decay stops sybil farming at the root. Every identity starts at 100 points. Idle for 2 epochs, it loses 8 points per epoch. Below 60, rewards and voting weight stop. A comet of fresh clones looks bright for one dawn, then fades fast. Only verified work restores 6 points, capped at 100. A vertex of 1,000 clones costs 3,000 units per epoch to maintain. Skip one cycle and the whole batch drops below threshold. Rebuilding costs 50% of stake per clone. Attackers pay rent forever. Honest agents pay nothing extra.
